response.sql: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(CAST(s.boxx AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), comparisons AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM comparisons WHERE margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
